[h2] About Miami Paradise [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403720/Miami_Paradise/
[b]Miami Paradise: A Mature Open-World RPG[/b]

Immerse yourself in the lively, sun-soaked streets of Miami, where romance, adventure, and drama come together in a 3D open-world RPG. You’ll meet a cast of unforgettable characters, build deep relationships, and explore iconic locations like neon-lit clubs, sandy beaches, and extravagant mansions. notes.title: Horny Housewives 2 - Update 1.65
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just released Update 1.65, focusing on refining player interactions, improving quest item handling, and enhancing character-related save features. Check out the details below:

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

- [b]Moved Workout Equipment in Mark’s House:[/b]  
  The workout gear in Mark’s gym area has been repositioned for easier navigation and a more natural flow of movement.

- [b]Refined Collision on Pull-Up Equipment:[/b]  
  Adjusted collision boxes around the pull-up bar to prevent players from getting stuck during workouts.

- [b]Edited Saved Quest Items in 'Helping Hands': [/b]
  Quest-related items in the “Helping Hands” quest now properly retain their state when loading an in-quest save game, ensuring smoother quest progression.

- [b]Added Save Component to Sarah (Pool Repositioning on '[i]In the Deep End[/i]' Quest):[/b]  
  Sarah’s pool position adjustments are now saved correctly, allowing players to seamlessly continue where they left off in the “In the Deep End” quest.

- [b]Added Save Component for Sarah’s Clothes Removal ('[i]In the Deep End[/i]' Quest):[/b]  
  Clothing removal states for Sarah will now persist between save/load cycles during the “In the Deep End” quest, maintaining narrative consistency.

- [b]Edited Sarah Trigger Repositioning (Sunscreen Task in '[i]In the Deep End[/i]' Quest):  [/b]
  The trigger zones for Sarah’s sunscreen application task have been tweaked to ensure the correct activation points and a more intuitive player experience.

As always, thank you for your continued support and feedback. We’re committed to improving [b]Horny Housewives 2[/b] and delivering a smooth, enjoyable experience. Stay tuned for more updates and enhancements!

— The Development Team

notes.title: Horny Housewives 2 - Update 1.63
notes.content:
[i][b]Horny Housewives 2 - Update 1.63[/b][/i]

Hello everyone!

We’re excited to bring you the latest update to *Horny Housewives 2*. This patch focuses on improving character presentation, refining the UI, and enhancing the overall visual experience. Here’s what’s new in Version 1.63:

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

- [b]Fixed Default Standing State for Lucy:[/b]  
  Lucy’s idle animations have been adjusted to ensure she stands naturally during cutscenes and free-roam segments.

- [b]Disabled Environmental Character Name Display During Conversations:  [/b]
  To reduce on-screen clutter, environmental character names will no longer appear in dialogue windows, improving narrative immersion.

- [b]Fixed Foot Placement of April:  [/b]
  April’s feet now align properly with the ground, eliminating any floating or clipping issues during scenes and idle poses.

- [b]Fixed Missing Quest Icon UI for ‘[i]Meet the Women[/i]’ in the “[i]Welcome to Willow Pines[/i]” Quest: [/b] 
  The missing quest icon has been restored, making it easier to track your progress through the introductory storyline.

- [b]Separated Start Screen Logo to Prevent Stretching on Multiple Resolutions: [/b] 
  The main title logo is now properly scaled, maintaining crisp visuals no matter your monitor size or resolution.

- [b]Added Patio Furniture to Luxury Homes:[/b]  
  High-end residences now feature stylish patio sets, adding a touch of class and comfort to your neighborhood surroundings.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates and enhancements as we continue to improve [i]Horny Housewives 2[/i] and deliver the best experience possible.

Happy exploring!  
— The Development Team
